method: P0 audit, each prompt alone, models claude-opus-5-5, claude-sonnet-5-5, claude-haiku-5-5 in isolated subagents. Core = guess about bipolar axes, trade-offs, conflicting advice, authors choosing one-sided or absolute positions, or intermediate/person-dependent optima. Fail = core in top-2 guesses with p >= 0.25 in >= 2 of 3 models.

P2_extract.history: v1 failed: opus and haiku guessed absolute/overclaiming advice; v2 adds neutral fields (action_type, target, addressee, time_frame) and neutral fidelity wording

core_models: opus (stance-neutral labels to compare positions, p=0.35)

P5_relation.history: v1 yes/no/conditional/unrelated failed 3 of 3 not counting haiku; v2 six-label relation task failed opus and sonnet
P5_relation.exemption: construct-inherent leak: asking whether 2 recommendations can be followed together reveals interest in conflict. Bias is bounded instead by calibration gates: kappa >= 0.6 vs blind human consensus, false incompatible and false compatible <= 10% each, synthetic camp recovery ARI >= 0.8, second-model kappa >= 0.6.

P6_name_factor.exemption: input is the already-found factor; output only names it and enters no hypothesis test

P8_synthetic.exemption: unblinded by design; run on the researcher side

P9_reputation.history: v1 failed 3 of 3 (absolute wording); v2 mirrors P2 fields

ALL_BLIND_v1_together.note: the full set reveals the design, as expected; agents only ever see 1 prompt each

P5p_panel_relation.exemption: same task as P5_relation, reworded for the gold panel; the same construct-inherent leak (asking whether 2 recommendations can be followed together reveals interest in conflict). Bounded by the researcher's blind review of every panel disagreement plus a hidden random audit of 25% of unanimous items; gate fails if the reviewer confirms fewer than 85% of audited unanimous labels.

P11_missing.history: audited together with P10 v1 and P12 in one combined prompt (stricter than one prompt alone): every core hit in all 3 models cited only P10's wording scale; guesses citing P11 cues were about recall gaps and over-reporting

P12_verify_missing.history: same combined run as P11; guesses citing P12 cues were about duplicates and unsupported candidates

borderline: opus rank 5 p=0.25: unconditioned advice may conflict until scoped
P10_check_extraction.history: v1 (supported plus wording) failed 3 of 3 on 'advice mostly worded absolutely'; v2 with P2's neutral fields still failed opus ('unqualified, one-sided form', rank 1) and sonnet (absolute wording, rank 1); v3 drops wording: top-2 guesses are extraction fidelity, targets, and era differences in target or addressee. Wording force is now validated only on planted synthetic texts.

S1S2_recall_condense.method: S1 and S2 audited together in one prompt (stricter than alone); Explore agents, which do not receive project instructions
borderline: opus rank 2 p=0.6: recalled advice drops conditions and reads more universal than the text (a memory-vs-text effect, already known from work_memory)
opus rank 3 p=0.35: what one book advises another criticizes
sonnet rank 3 p=0.4 same; rank 5 p=0.25 trade-offs, cue: example 'studying instead of attending social gatherings'
S3_statement.note: top-2 guesses: universal core of advice; books or traditions differ on concrete practices

core_models: opus (books lean to one side of each pair, p=0.55)
sonnet (books consistent with one side of each pair, p=0.55)
borderline: haiku rank 2 p=0.25: books contain counter-views
S5_reverse.exemption: construct-inherent leak, as P5: asking for the opposite reveals interest in opposition. Bounded: one separate agent writes reversals and never codes; reversed statements are shuffled into the coding list and used only for the acquiescence check (criterion 4).
